subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should standalone JSON assistant text become executable by default for every `createPlainTextToolCallCompatWrapper` caller, or should providers explicitly opt into this additional repair format?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent but changes shared plugin-facing fallback policy for existing providers; fallback ownership and upgrade behavior require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in
options.body: Keep the shared parser but require each provider wrapper to enable JSON promotion explicitly after provider-specific proof.

options.title: Shared default promotion
options.body: Enable JSON promotion for all current wrapper callers and accept the upgrade behavior after exact-path live proof.

options.title: Native Ollama only
options.body: Narrow or pause this PR and resolve the linked report through canonical native Ollama configuration or native response normalization.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the shared parser but require each provider wrapper to enable JSON promotion explicitly after provider-specific proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the broadest recent involvement in provider runtime, plugin SDK policy, and plain-text repair behavior.
